question: Can exact source provenance and verified RNA completion facts be preserved for scoped offline integration?
decision: Archive exact input records and collect existing verified facts without new biological calculations.
strongest_rival: An export could omit source versions, confuse failed execution with success, or hide remaining scientific holds.
discriminator: Byte-for-byte source archive and existing receipt/summary facts; no new endpoint or statistical test.
exposure_record: All preceding metadata and descriptive outputs exposed. This stage only preserves provenance and assembles existing facts.
biological_unit: Not applicable for archive; biological summaries retain one observed pool per reported condition.
nesting_and_overlap: S1 reports one old-control mouse and two pooled mice in the other main libraries, with no multiplexing. Shared controls serve both dose contrasts. Individual donor assignment requires separate provenance.
population_and_selection: All retained cells in the authorized main IL10_svz_seurat.rds and original broad Celltype annotations. No fresh clustering, integration, downsampling or marker-based exclusion.
contrast: Exact source bytes and already verified table rows; no new biological comparison.
endpoint: Three exact provenance records and a machine-readable seven-stage completion summary.
methods: Copy and SHA-256 verify three source records; copy illustrative existing rows and validation facts; retain complete summary and contrast locators.
missingness_and_exclusions: No new exclusions. Missing fields, absent genes/conditions, explicit sparse zeros, duplicate/misaligned barcodes and source discrepancies are reported. A failed required check stops dependent analyses rather than selecting favorable records.
multiplicity: Metadata and arithmetic checks only; no inferential P values or confidence intervals.
precision_basis: No population precision estimate. Exact stored recovery counts and bounded numerical tolerance qualify file arithmetic only.
interpretation_limit: No biological replication, population treatment effect, age interaction, mediation or repair inference. Downstream microglia exclusions and filename changes must remain distinct from broad deposited cells.
stop_rule: Stop if source hashes differ, archive membership changes, or descriptive independent verification did not pass.
amendment_reason: Completion/provenance packaging after successful frozen descriptive execution.
